propositions: Bare-repository test fixtures fail during setup when safe.bareRepository=explicit because they route git commands through cwd-based helpers that invoke implicit repository discovery, which Git 2.55+ rejects under explicit policy.
git config gc.autoDetach false and git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/tickets return exit 128 (fatal errors) when invoked on bare repositories via cwd or -C without explicit --git-dir targeting.
The failure is reproducible on pristine origin/main using isolated command-scoped GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=dev/null and safe.bareRepository=explicit without mutating host/global Git settings.
Changing bare-repository commands to use explicit --git-dir targeting resolves the failures while preserving worktree helper behavior and all existing safety contracts.
Production code in prepare_reclaim_backup.py::_verify_restore exhibits the same implicit bare-discovery defect at its temporary restore.git repository and requires the same targeting repair.

The repair introduces narrow bare-only Git helpers at confirmed test/script call sites, does not weaken any Git safety setting, and preserves all upkeep pins, refs, error handling, and fail-fast behavior.
